clips.send: A small business owner who keeps re-shooting their sales video sends this to a friend stuck in perfectionism, proof that one unscripted take sold $450 million.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau filmed his very first infomercial in 1989 in Fairfield, Iowa - home to one of the biggest Transcendental Meditation communities in the country.

He picked the location on purpose: he believed the energy there, the vibration of the place, mattered more than the script.

He went up, spoke for about an hour, and that was it. No retakes, no second take, no polish.

That single, unscripted recording went on to sell $450 million in Mega Memory home-study courses.

Would you trust one take over twenty rehearsed ones?
